name: Fiacclach mac Conchinn

attributes.attribute: foster father of Fionn Mac Cumhaill

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fiacclach mac Conchinn, also called Fiacail or Fiachu mac Conga, was an Irish hero. As his vigorous foster father, he raised the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill. He handed Fionn a sword whose aim never failed.

okr.objective: Fiacclach mac Conchinn is an Irish hero who fostered Fionn Mac Cumhaill and gave him a magic sword.
key_results: Fiacclach mac Conchinn was an Irish hero.
He was the vigorous foster father of Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
He gave Fionn a magical sword that never missed its mark.
